questions.prompt: To which people do Frodo and Bilbo belong?
questions.explanation: Hobbits are a small, peaceful people who live mostly in the Shire.

questions.prompt: To which people does Gimli belong?
questions.explanation: Dwarves are sturdy, secretive miners and smiths who live under mountains.

questions.prompt: Which ancient beings are the shepherds of the trees?
questions.explanation: Treebeard is the eldest of the Ents, who watch over the forests.

questions.prompt: Which foul creatures, also called goblins, serve Sauron and Saruman?
questions.explanation: Orcs were bred in the First Age by the Dark Lord Morgoth.

questions.prompt: To which immortal people do Legolas and Galadriel belong?
questions.explanation: Elves do not age or die of old age, but they can be slain or die of grief.

questions.prompt: What name is given to the large, strong orcs bred by Saruman at Isengard?
questions.explanation: The Uruk-hai can bear sunlight better than other orcs.

questions.prompt: Which people of Rohan are famed as horse-lords?
questions.explanation: The Rohirrim breed the finest horses in Middle-earth, including the Mearas.

questions.prompt: What are the nine servants of Sauron, once kings of Men, called?
questions.explanation: The Nazgûl, or Ringwraiths, were enslaved by the Nine Rings.

questions.prompt: Which creatures in The Hobbit are turned to stone by the light of dawn?
questions.explanation: Gandalf keeps the three trolls arguing until the sun rises and turns them to stone.

questions.prompt: To which race do Boromir and King Théoden belong?
questions.explanation: Men are mortal and are known in Elvish as the Second-born.

questions.prompt: What name is given to the Men of Númenórean descent in Middle-earth, such as Aragorn?
questions.explanation: Dúnedain means 'Men of the West'; they are descendants of the Númenóreans.

questions.prompt: Which people of the south fight for Sauron with great oliphaunts?
questions.explanation: The Haradrim come from Harad, south of Gondor and Mordor.

questions.prompt: What is the collective name for the order of wizards sent to Middle-earth?
questions.explanation: The Istari took the shape of old men to counsel and aid the free peoples.

questions.prompt: Which Elven kindred included Fëanor?
questions.explanation: The Noldor were famed for their craft and their love of knowledge.

questions.prompt: Which folk, descended from Beorn, live near Mirkwood and can take the shape of bears?
questions.explanation: Beorn befriends Bilbo and the Dwarves in The Hobbit and fights at the Battle of Five Armies.

questions.prompt: Thorin Oakenshield belongs to the line of which Dwarf-father?
questions.explanation: Durin's Folk are Dwarves who trace their line to Durin the Deathless.

questions.prompt: What are the Elves of Lothlórien and Mirkwood mostly called?
questions.explanation: Silvan Elves are woodland folk, ruled by Sindarin or Noldorin lords.

questions.prompt: Which people from beyond the Gap of Rohan are enemies of the Rohirrim and allied with Saruman?
questions.explanation: Dunlendings had been driven from the lands the Rohirrim settled.

questions.prompt: What kind of beings were Gandalf and Sauron before they took their forms in Middle-earth?
questions.explanation: Maiar are lesser spirits of the same order as the Valar.

questions.prompt: Which of these peoples has no member in the Fellowship of the Ring?
questions.explanation: The Fellowship has four Hobbits, two Men, an Elf, a Dwarf and a wizard.

questions.prompt: To which of the three Hobbit breeds did Sméagol's family belong?
questions.explanation: Stoors lived near rivers and were comfortable on boats and in water.

questions.prompt: What name is given to the Elves who refused the summons to travel west at the beginning?
questions.explanation: Avari means 'the Unwilling'; they stayed in the east of Middle-earth.

questions.prompt: Which people of the Drúadan Forest, called Woses, help the Rohirrim reach Gondor?
questions.explanation: The Drúedain guide the Rohirrim along a hidden path to Minas Tirith.

questions.prompt: What were the Faithful of Númenor, who remained friends of the Elves, called?
questions.explanation: Elendili means 'Elf-friends'; Elendil, who led the survivors, belonged to them.

questions.prompt: To which of the Three Houses of the Edain did Húrin belong?
questions.explanation: Húrin and his brother Huor were of the House of Hador, as was Túrin, Húrin's son.

questions.prompt: Which of the three Hobbit breeds was the most numerous?
questions.explanation: Harfoots preferred hills and burrows, and were the most numerous of the Hobbit breeds.

questions.prompt: In their own secret tongue, what do the Dwarves call themselves?
questions.explanation: Naugrim is the Elvish name for the Dwarves, not their own.

questions.prompt: Which Elven kindred was ruled by King Thingol in Doriath?
questions.explanation: The Sindar, or Grey-elves, were the Elves who remained in Beleriand.

questions.prompt: What is the Sindarin name for the Hobbits?
questions.explanation: Periannath means 'Halflings'; Onodrim is the Elvish name for the Ents.

questions.prompt: Which Elven kindred lived closest to the Valar, on Taniquetil?
questions.explanation: The Vanyar were the first to reach Valinor and remained in the light of the Trees.
